core_obligations: Converse: 1 + i in Ann(I) from D = B
difficulty_reason: The Noether different cuts out the non-unramified locus: unramified localizes and forces Omega_{B/A} = 0 whence D = B; conversely a principal localization with D = B exhibits 1 + i in the annihilator of I, which forces I/I^2 = Omega_{B/A} = 0 and hence unramifiedness. Retained author proof at lines 1531-1553.
